suite: Amalgam launcher comprehensive visual-QA fixture plan
evidenceLabel: DETERMINISTIC LOCAL FIXTURE — not live player, provider, account, server, or Bedrock evidence

routeSyntax.scope: The suffix controls the shell's page-level scroll host. The Account setup fixture, static server-file preview, and static Create Server modal body also honor it for their bounded content bodies, so @bottom can prove lower consent, submit, security, footer, static-file, and modal-form composition without synthesizing input; it does not otherwise scroll nested tables, consoles, or virtualized lists.

primaryDesktop.purpose: Primary visual record for every registered fixture token plus the selected middle and bottom checkpoints.

compactDesktop.selection: Every case whose id appears in compactHighRiskCaseIds
compactDesktop.purpose: Detect density, wrapping, clipping, and hierarchy regressions on a common compact desktop viewport.

smallDesktop.selection: Every case whose id appears in smallHighRiskCaseIds
smallDesktop.purpose: Stress compact layouts, dense tabs, destructive actions, dialogs, and first-run flows.

responsiveMatrix.executionNote: Run tools/capture-launcher-visual-qa.ps1 with -ViewportCasePlan ManifestResponsive to apply the primary all-cases tier and the compact/small high-risk lists per viewport. The runner validates the lists and writes the exact resulting pairs to case-selection.json; use -ViewportCasePlan All for an intentional all-cases or focused re-check.
